study type: prospective study with qualitative (individual interviews) and quantitative (questionnaire) components
exposure: Caesarean section at full cervical dilatation
outcome: techniques for performing Caesarean section at full cervical dilatation
clinical components of a successful Caesarean section at full cervical dilatation
finding: The study identified several essential clinical components of a skillfully and safely performed Caesarean section at full cervical dilatation, including routine re-examination of the patient in the operating room and specific surgical modifications.
mod_finding: The study focuses on identifying essential clinical components of performing a safe and effective cesarean section at full cervical dilatation.
